eras.title: Houses beneath the cliff
eras.caption: At Mesa Verde, Ancestral Pueblo builders fitted rooms and towers into sheltered sandstone alcoves. The surviving masonry and circular kivas preserve the layout of communities that later moved away from these cliff dwellings.
